name: Witherweird Runes AP OLD
source: Pathfinder #199: To Bloom Below the Web
description: Necromantic magic stored in runes painted in powdered bone and banshees' tears lash out at anyone other than Heh Shan-Bao who opens the secondary compartment.
disable: Disable device dc=37 to scratch out the runes and dissipate their magic harmlessly, DC 40 Arcana to sabotage the spell and cause the runes to dry up and blow away as inert powder, or Dispel Magic (7th rank; counteract DC 31) to counteract the runes

offensiveAbilities.name: Withering Wail
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Someone other than Heh Shan-Bao opens the secondary compartment

Effect A howling, spectral face manifests out of the chest and screeches, causing all within area C4 to attempt a DC 33 Fortitude Saving Throw save; the sound also alerts the jiang-shi in areas C3 a and C6, who quickly come to investigate the sound.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes 7d6 Void Damage damage.

Failure The creature takes 15d6 Void Damage damage. In addition, their flesh withers and weakens, leaving them to appear old and decrepit—the creature becomes Clumsy 1 and Enfeebled 1 until the curse is removed.

Critical Failure The creature takes 30d6 Void Damage damage and becomes cursed as failure, but becomes Clumsy 2 and Enfeebled 2.
